name: XCOM_Sectoid
contact_shadow: painted dark occlusion patch under each foot + a real cast shadow from the overhead reveal_cast spot
silh_plate: shape-only plate: black silhouette on flat mid-grey, no ground, no lights
silhouette: small + gaunt, oversized smooth cranium, symmetric glowing eyes, NO mouth (nasal slit + brow ridge + chin plate), stick-thin limbs that end at the hip - the smallest frame in the kit
changed_vs_v1: v1 read as the same generic biped and v2 still stood to attention like a mannequin. v3: the torso is pitched 22 deg forward about the pelvis and the head an extra 8 deg, so the figure is a compact forward-curved hunch; the shoulders are a rounded, UNEQUAL mass rather than a level bar; the cranium merges into a fleshy nape instead of a mechanical collar; the eyes are alien almond eyes (dark socket, dark ball, glowing lens) with no chrome bezel; there is no mouth (nasal slit, brow ridge, chin plate); the legs are short, tapered and knee-bent with the weight on the right leg; the hands are enlarged and clasped forward and outboard so the gesture breaks the torso outline; and both feet have a tight dark contact patch on the floor.
contact_shadow_source: tight dark occlusion patch painted under each foot + a real cast shadow from the 700 W near-vertical reveal_cast spot

name: XCOM_Floater
contact_shadow: soft body-shaped hover ellipse on the floor; nothing touches the ground
silh_plate: shape-only plate: black silhouette on flat mid-grey, no ground, no lights
silhouette: LEGLESS broad manta parasite: ONE continuous swept planform from tip to tip (2.5 m span, no separate wing parts and no notches), a low segmented glowing dorsal core, and NOTHING under the body - no legs, no feet, no rods, no rounded tips; it hovers over a soft body-shaped ellipse
changed_vs_v1: v1 gave the Floater legs. v2 still had FIVE descending rods ending in glowing spheres, which read as a spider stance. v3: those rods and spheres are DELETED - there is no leg, no foot, no descending appendage and no rounded tip under the body; the only appendage is a pair of hair-fine filaments trailing off the REAR, angled upward so they can never read as limbs. The body is now ONE continuous swept manta planform from tip to tip (2.5 m span) instead of a body plus separate wing parts, so the underside has no lobes or notches that could be mistaken for limbs; the dorsal core is three low segmented lens segments (no canopy/dome); and the body-shaped hover ellipse on the floor is the only thing beneath it.
contact_shadow_source: soft body-shaped hover ellipse on the floor; nothing touches the ground
